name: spectrum-7b-capacity-sweep
description: Capacity sweep for SPECTRUM spectral_soft(tau=1) on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, 1 round, MBPP full eval (500 tasks x16), seed 43. Sequential in one H100: train_samples {64,128} at rank=8, then LoRA rank {16,32,64} at train_samples=16. Prior result: all operators (soft/hard/blend, directional fraction 4.6%-71%) give nearly identical pass@k, so the operator is not the bottleneck; this sweeps data volume and LoRA capacity instead.
